name: Patience
q: Food eaten in haste chokes you
Patience is bitter, its fruit sweet
The patient gain only more patience
Slow but steady wins the race
He that can have patience can have what he will
Good days come to those who endure
Impatience in small things ruins great plans
Patience is the art of hoping
What can't be mended, patience eases
Patience and time do more than strength or passion
Nothing happens that you cannot bear
The peach tree does not speak, yet a path forms beneath it
All noble things are rare and hard
Endure, my heart; you have borne worse
Who can wait quietly while the muddy water settles clear?
